title: Tinderwick - First Light on the Water
_note: Explore-light / Light-leaning ambient. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 88 BPM, 4/4, C Lydian-tinted major (raised 4th = F# for wonder). Lead = sparse, ONLY the motif's lift fragment (G3->C4->D4) answered by silence - fewer notes than A. Harmony(bell-timbre via pulse12) = bright ascending sparkle figures (Light signature) like candle-windows on the sea. Bass = very slow sustained roots, almost a drone. Percussion = a single soft noise shimmer at the loop seam. 16 bars.

tracks._note: Only the Vesper lift fragment G3->C4->D4, then silence. The question left unanswered. F# (Lydian #4) glints once. Sparse, lots of rest.
